Dr. Ali Abedi joined UWM in 2025 after 20 years on the faculty at the University of Maine, where he directed research on wireless communications and sensor networks with applications in environmental and structural monitoring, space explorations and biomedical devices. He also served as Associate Vice President for Research, Director of Experiential Programs Innovation Central (EPIC), the Center for Undergraduate Research (CUGR), and Innovative Media Research and Commercialization Center (IMRC)

Before joining UWM, John spent more than 22 years at Loyola University Chicago, where he most recently served as Associate Vice President for Digital Marketing & Communications. During his tenure, he held leadership roles spanning marketing, communications, digital strategy and organizational operations, helping advance institutional reputation, enrollment objectives and stakeholder engagement.
John earned a Bachelor of Business Administration from the University of Notre Dame.
